plain_english_summary: Each store-family keeps its recently observed promotion frequency (mean share 42% of days) and oil stays at 47.3. Planning baseline: 24,764,504 units over 30 days (P10-P90 24,018,089 to 24,842,392).

Promotion frequency +30%, oil -10%, and a holiday flag on the first 5 days: +10.1% units vs base (P10-P90 +3.4% to +11.1%). Oil alone moves the forecast very little; most of the change is the promotion assumption.
Promotions paused entirely and oil +15%: -4.6% units vs base (P10-P90 -7.3% to -1.2%). This is essentially a 'no promotions' case.
